title: koredocs_update_with_expected_revision
prompts: Using KoreDocs MCP: create a koredoc in folder /Tests/UpdateTests, filename revision-check.koredoc, content: Revision check document - initial.
Using koredocs_file_update: update that file with content 'Revision check document - updated.' Pass expected_revision=1 (the initial revision). Report success or failure and the new revision number.
